title: Property title records
definition: The register of title for the property, showing the registered proprietor, the charges registered and the dates of transfer. It is requested because the registered proprietor is a different question from the person who paid, and it establishes the ownership and encumbrance position independently of the parties.
evidence_to_cite: the register of title, with the date of retrieval
the registered proprietor and the dates of transfer
the registered charges, and the amounts secured

sources.citation: Independent ownership evidence for real estate assessment, summarised in the FinCrime regulatory index.
